entry.name: AI for Everyone
entry.note: A non-technical course on what AI can and cannot do inside an organisation

reading.cost: The page offers the option to join for free. It also refers to purchasing a Certificate, which it says gives access to all course materials including graded assignments, but it does not state a price. It notes that in select learning programs you can apply for financial aid or a scholarship if you cannot afford the enrollment fee.
covers: Common AI terminology, including neural networks, machine learning, deep learning and data science
What AI realistically can and cannot do
Spotting opportunities to apply AI to problems in your own organization
What it feels like to build machine learning and data science projects
Working with an AI team and building an AI strategy
Ethical and societal discussions surrounding AI
Workflow of a machine learning project
Choosing an AI project and technical tools for AI teams
reading.format: An online course at beginner level, available in 27 languages, made up of video items with some marked optional. The page lists graded assignments and says that on completing the course an electronic Certificate is added to your Accomplishments page.
reading.summary: AI for Everyone is an online beginner level course from DeepLearning.AI offered on Coursera. It explains common AI terms and what AI can and cannot do, and it looks at how organizations can find and run AI projects. The page says the course is largely non-technical and that finishing it gives an electronic Certificate, which can be printed or added to a LinkedIn profile.
reading.audience: The page says it is for anyone who wants their organization to get better at using AI, especially non-technical colleagues. It adds that engineers can also take it to learn the business side of AI.
reading.prerequisites: None stated. The page lists the course as beginner level.
